data.name: Hanani
data.gender_notes: Hanani is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'hannana' which means 'to be gracious, merciful, compassionate'. In the Quran, Allah is described as the Most Merciful and Compassionate. The name Hanani carries the meaning “Gracious, Merciful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hanani usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious, merciful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who embodies the qualities of compassion, kindness, and mercy.
data.etymology: Hanani belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gracious, Merciful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hanani total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: حنانى
in_arabic.meaning: حنانى تعنى الشخص الذى يحمل قلبا حنونا و رحيما
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حنانى مشتق من الجذر 'ح ن ن' الذى يدل على الرحمة و الشفقة. و هو اسم يدل على الشخص الذى يحمل قلبا حنونا و رحيما، و يتصف بالعطف و الإحساس العميق. كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة آل عمران: 'وَتَحْسَبُ أَنَّهُمْ أَقْوَامٌ وَحِدٌ وَمَا هُمُ إِلَّا رِجَالٌ مُتَفَرِقُونَ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمُ النَّجِيُّ الَّذِي يَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ ثُمَّ مَثَّلَ إِلَيْهِمُ الْمَوْتَ سَيِّدُ اللَّهِ حَنَانِيَّهُ'.

in_urdu.name: حنانى
in_urdu.meaning: حنانى کا مطلب ہے رحیم اور مہربان شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: حنانى نام عربی جڑ 'ح ن ن' سے نکلا ہے، جو رحمت اور شفقت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ یہ نام ایک ایسے شخص کو مخاطب کرتا ہے جو دل سے رحیم اور مہربان ہو، اور جو عاطفہ اور گہری محسوسات کا حامل ہو۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان اس نام کی روایات اور استعمال کا ایک خاص ثقافتی سیاق و سباق ہے۔

in_english.name: Hanani
in_english.meaning: Hanani means one who is merciful and compassionate
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hanani is derived from the Arabic root 'ح ن ن' (ḥ-n-n), which signifies mercy, compassion, and tenderness. It refers to an individual who is characterized by their merciful and compassionate nature. The name has a strong Quranic and Islamic heritage, reflecting the values of empathy and kindness. Hanani is used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the ideal of being a caring and understanding person.
